architecture.mechanism: Advanced three-stage charging profile applied via an additional power converter to regulate lead-acid battery charging and prevent thermal failure.
architecture.intervention: Install an inline DC-DC converter between the OEM alternator output and the 12V Subaru starting battery that enforces a three-stage charging profile (bulk, absorption, float) compatible with the 12V automotive electrical system, preventing overcharge-induced thermal runaway and sudden full discharge.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of thermal failure events by preventing excessive gassing and plate degradation during charging, maintaining battery capacity and ensuring reliable remote unlock and engine cranking capability.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject the modified battery system to continuous OEM alternator charging at 45°C ambient temperature for 72 hours; measure battery surface temperature and terminal voltage every 5 minutes. If internal temperature exceeds 60°C or open-circuit voltage drops below 10.5V post-test, the intervention has failed.
